description: This Java class 'MD5Checksum' provides methods to compute MD5 hash checksums for files, including creating a checksum byte array and converting it to a hexadecimal string.

classes.name: MD5Checksum
classes.description: A utility class for generating MD5 checksums of files.

methods.name: createChecksum
methods.description: Reads a file and computes its MD5 checksum as a byte array.

methods.name: getMD5Checksum
methods.description: Returns the MD5 checksum of a file as a hexadecimal string.
